properties.name: Központi városrész
properties.approximationNotes: Actual four-colour source extent, traced from the 2015 municipal study. Coloured legends excluded. Source has built-up/function-oriented extents rather than complete administrative city land. Coarse affine image placement estimated from regional map labels; independent geographic accuracy not established. Distinct parent groups intentionally overlap finer named neighbourhoods. Not an official current cadastral boundary.

properties.name: Susa
properties.approximationNotes: Estimated populated footprint only. north-west detached built-up island; component/name association inferred from the source valley/road description. Source shape retained and approximately centred on the known locality point, because the coarse full-map georeferencing is unreliable at outlying villages. Not a circle, not a complete official or cadastral boundary. Source-based size and shape remain approximate.
